verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework with a CLI, and a framework's tooling could plausibly ship a built-in assistant, so this axis applies. The pack shows no built-in AI assistant to delegate tasks to. The AI-related evidence (scaffolded AGENTS.md, Markdown docs routes, /llms-full.txt) only helps external agents consume Proa context; that is adjacent support for outside tools, not an in-product assistant.
